description: This file defines Vulkan-specific operations and context for linear and weight packing in PyTorch, including a template function for weight staging and a class for packed linear context management.

classes.name: LinearPackedContext
classes.description: A class managing packed linear layer context for Vulkan backend, including packing and unpacking weights and biases.

methods.name: stage_pack_weights
methods.description: Templates function to stage and pack weights into a Vulkan tensor buffer.

methods.name: LinearPackedContext
methods.description: Constructor for creating a packed linear context with weights and optional bias.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Static method to pack a generic list into a LinearPackedContext.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Method to retrieve the unpacked list of tensors from the context.

methods.name: create_linear_context
methods.description: Function to create a new LinearPackedContext with given weight and bias.

methods.name: run_linear_context
methods.description: Function to execute a linear operation using the packed context.

methods.name: run_qlinear_context
methods.description: Function to execute a quantized linear operation with the packed context.
